verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents a Live mode in which the client streams binary PCM16 or Opus audio over a WebSocket and receives partial captions plus completed transcript items as speech is processed. Inline vocabulary can be updated mid-session via session.update events, and the mode accepts Zoom RTMS audio. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the live WebSocket stream, and the partial-results captions feature is still marked preview.
